answer.says: Ramesh, the arrangement is not as it should be. The file is gone for orders, and Mr. Saxena has asked me to wait fifteen days. But it is only Tuesday, and the matter of the queried vouchers remains unsettled. I intend to go to the Directorate this afternoon to press for clarity. Can you keep the house in order while I am out?
answer.thought: The hunger is a practical matter, but the anxiety regarding the file is a movement in my spirit that food alone will not settle. I must speak to Ramesh now, before I eat, to ensure the household stands firm while I deal with the bureaucracy. The state is the actuality of the ethical idea, yet here it appears as a mere obstruction to my own existence.
